title: qBittorrent
comment: qBittorrent's --profile directory (qBittorrent/config/qBittorrent.conf, qBittorrent/data/BT_backup) carries as one tree; the Daemonless image runs it with --profile=/config, and so does the official qbittorrent-nox image, which is the only Linux image listed here and the export target. The WebUI port is the image's WEBUI_PORT (8080); the source's port setting inside qBittorrent.conf is superseded. The LinuxServer and hotio images are deliberately NOT listed (the internal development record): LinuxServer keeps settings and state together in /config/qBittorrent (no --profile, XDG dirs at /config) and hotio keeps them in /config/config and /config/data. Carried as one tree the settings file is missing where Daemonless looks, its cont-init writes a default one, and the app starts with defaults and no torrents. Their layouts need per-image source layouts (the internal development record); do not re-add them here.
